overview: A tropical neon beach and sea conditions app for Kish Island, showing live marine and weather data, beach comparisons, an interactive island map, community reports and an admin console.
features: Large tropical hero homepage with current sea conditions
Live marine and weather data with hourly and seven-day forecasts
Beach comparison ranked for swimming, fishing, surfing, water sports, kayaking and paddleboarding
Interactive Kish Island map with glowing beach markers
Community beach reports and official warnings
Admin console for beaches, reports and warnings
English and Persian with full right-to-left layout
